name: Glaze
soft_passes: #1 mask discipline — designed for the squircle but the PNG bakes the rounded corners (transparent) and an edge-bevel rim highlight instead of shipping a full-bleed unmasked layer
#3 silhouette test — filled black it is an abstract four-lobed pillow; passes only because it reproduces the glaze brand mark; genericness risk vs other abstract blobs
#4 16px squint — survives as a glowing amber blob on black, but caustics/sparkles/refraction/indigo rim all smear away below ~48px; identity survives as colour, not shape
#6 palette economy — clean 2 families + neutral field, but each family packs a wide tonal range that could read as more hues in a thumbnail
#9 era coherence — internally consistent but fuses skeuomorphic-glass photorealism with Liquid-Glass iridescence into a no-single-era custom language
failures: #10 variant robustness — composition wholly depends on the dark ground and full-colour iridescence; the subject IS the multicolour glass, so no viable macOS 26 mono/tinted/clear render; not authored as appearance-aware layers, fixed dark-only render art

palette.background: ramp #2D2D30->#0F1012 (near-black charcoal vignette; baked edge-bevel rim ~#606062; corners transparent/masked)

light_model: Environmental/studio glass: emissive molten amber core glowing from within (upper-centre) + refractive indigo shell on the lobes; specular glints and suspended sparkle particles imply an upper key light; chromatic dispersion at glass edges; baked squircle top rim-light agrees. One coherent 3D light setup, specular present.

indigo/blue refractive glass shell (rim + four lobes)
devices: brand mark as molten glass marble (quatrefoil logo rendered as a volumetric fluid blob)
warm/cool thermal split (emissive amber core vs refractive indigo rim inside one object)
caustic sparkle dust (suspended star particles selling a live fluid sim)
obsidian gallery field (near-black vignette as a lighting rig, dark-mode-native)
rhymes_hint: current AI-startup wave of abstract 3D glass/chrome/liquid-metal blobs on dark fields (iridescent-orb / oil-on-water / molten-glass-marble family); also skeuomorphic glass-material icons and Apple Liquid Glass material vocabulary quoted as baked render art. A 'dark-field iridescent-blob' AI-category cluster looks likely to form.
notes: 512x512 web render from macapp.supply, NOT a 1024 master; corners transparent (pre-masked), edge bevel and rim-light baked into the PNG; all hex measured at 512 and internal fluid detail is high-frequency (sampled, not authoritative). Silhouette echoes the quatrefoil brand mark in cover.jpg. Brand-coherence: cover.jpg is a strictly MONOCHROME black/white liquid-glass system with only faint chromatic-aberration glints on wave crests; the icon shares the black-liquid-glass-on-black motif and quatrefoil shape but breaks monochrome, cranking those glints into full amber/indigo iridescence — the loud member of a disciplined brand. Era-lag note: AI-category icon chases the Liquid Glass material trend (ahead of the flat Big-Sur dev-utility icons in the corpus) but as un-layered render art, so it still fails the real system-variant test (#10).
